# `flow_checkout_tr`

Reconcile a confined workspace to the exact base or head source boundary of one or more transports.

Defined in [`packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/flow-checkout-tr.ts`](https://github.com/abapify/adt-cli/blob/main/packages/adt-mcp/src/lib/tools/flow-checkout-tr.ts).

## Input schema

| Parameter         | Type       | Required | Description                                                             |
| ----------------- | ---------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `baseUrl`         | `string`   | no       | SAP system base URL (e.g. https://host:8000)                            |
| `client`          | `string`   | no       | SAP client number                                                       |
| `username`        | `string`   | no       | Username for basic auth                                                 |
| `password`        | `string`   | no       | Password for basic auth                                                 |
| `systemId`        | `string`   | no       | Logical system id (resolved via multi-system config or ~/.adt sessions) |
| `transports`      | `string[]` | yes      |                                                                         |
| `base`            | `boolean`  | no       |                                                                         |
| `verifyInventory` | `boolean`  | no       | Recompute transport inventory instead of reusing an exact-head index    |
| `workspaceRoot`   | `string`   | yes      | Absolute target directory within a server-owned root                    |

**Annotations**

- `readOnlyHint`: `false`
- `destructiveHint`: `true`
- `idempotentHint`: `true`
- `openWorldHint`: `true`

## Output

The tool returns a single text content item whose body is a JSON-serialised object (`content[0].text`). On error, the response has `isError: true` and a human-readable message.

```json
{
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<JSON.stringify(result, null, 2)>" }]
}
```

See the source for the exact shape of `result`.
